{{Quote|This is taking too long. Destroy that cruiser.''"<br />"''But sir, there are still hundreds of droids on board!''"<br />"''I don't care.|The droid and TF-1726|<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref>}}
This '''battle droid''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] that participated in the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] against [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and served under [[TF-1726/Legends|TF-1726's]] command.

==Biography==
This droid served as a droid gunner during the [[Sky Battle of Quell|Battle of Quell]] aboard a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and fired upon Aayla Secura's cruiser the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']] along with other cruisers. During the battle, [[TF-1726/Legends|the droid commander's]] ships had crippled the enemy fleet and had ordered this droid to send in the [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]]. Later in the battle, master [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], came to aid Aayla aboard [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] to rescue the remaining survivors. Then this droid was ordered to destroy the cruiser. The droid reminded TF-1726 that there were still droids fighting inside the ship, but TF-1726 had no concern for them. The droid followed the command, and the cruisers fired all batteries at the defenseless ship, which caused it to explode, leaving Skywalker severely damaged but failed to stop the Jedi on board their escape ship.
